title: Bundle Lock Manifest (v1)
description: Schema for bundles/<profile-id>/<revision-sha256>/bundle.lock.json, the deterministic lock file internal/profile.BuildBundlePlan plans to render (as a "render" Action, see migration-manifest.schema.json) after all of a bundle revision's assets have been copied and verified. Bundle revisions are generated, immutable, hash-locked directory materializations of a canonical profile — never a source of truth. No Go type defines this file's contents yet (BuildBundlePlan only plans the write); this schema is forward-looking and documents the intended, currently-planned shape so tooling and docs agree on file naming and the revision identifier's type ahead of implementation.

profileId.description: Must equal the profile-id path segment in bundles/<profileId>/<revision>/bundle.lock.json.

revision.description: SHA-256 of the canonical profile's exact JSON encoding at generation time (internal/profile's unexported revision() function: sha256(json.Marshal(profile))). Must equal the enclosing directory segment. This is a content digest, not a monotonically increasing counter — any change to the profile document produces a new, unrelated-looking revision hash.

inputs.description: Asset content addresses consumed to materialize this revision.

immutable.description: Always true. Once written, a revision's files are never edited in place; changes always produce a new revision directory (a new profile content hash).

files.description: Every materialized file in this revision, path-relative to the revision root (bundles/<profileId>/<revision>/), with its exact-byte hash for lock verification. Matches the destination paths internal/profile.BuildBundlePlan computes: assets/<safe-game-key>/<role>.<extension> plus this lock file itself.
